functions.name: H
functions.description: Ask Claude about the whole workbook (reads every sheet). Text answer.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: What to ask, e.g. "which region grew fastest?"

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional: default Claude Sonnet; or "claude:haiku" / "claude:opus", or a local Ollama model name

functions.name: DO
functions.description: Fill other cells from an instruction. Preview first; apply=TRUE writes it once. Never deletes or overwrites.

parameters.name: instruction
parameters.description: What to fill, e.g. "fill Revenue in Raw Data column J as Quantity × Unit Price"

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: FALSE/omitted = preview only; TRUE = write the previewed edits (once)

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional: default Claude Sonnet; or "claude:haiku" / "claude:opus", or a local Ollama model name

functions.name: UNDO
functions.description: Undo one LOOOKUP.DO run (clears the cells it filled, unless you changed them since).
